name: anbu
description: Anbu - a multilingual, privacy-respecting AI companion that listens (PWA + Express API).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
